We’ve been baking delicious hand-rolled pretzels since 1994, when we opened our first outlet in Puerto Rico. Since then we’ve grown and grown, until today we have more than 160 outlets in 17 countries.Using only the finest quality, natural ingredients, our pretzel dough is prepared on the spot, so freshness and taste are guaranteed. No wonder people keep coming back for more – across the world we serve literally thousands of pretzels every day.What’s more, our pretzels are made with wholemeal wheat, are low in fat and contain no preservatives.
